- Policy-side note (reported, not a KB verdict): `check_and_unclaimed_terms_schedule` carries the parameter_schema descriptions of `check_reissue_free_count` ("Reissues of one payout made free of charge") and `check_reissue_fee` ("Fee deducted from a reissued check beyond the free reissues"), and its "Terms explained" restates them: "One reissue of a payout is made without charge; the $15.00 fee is the fee deducted from a reissued check beyond the free reissue." This per-payout, single-fee reading is the semantics of the clause `capital_ext_check_replacement` retired; the source left the schema descriptions unchanged, so the KB faithfully shows a source-layer tension with the current rule (voids counted on the whole account; $25.00 beyond two). In this task's world both readings give $15.00 (two voids, both in one chain), and the visible corpus marks the chain clause retired (check_void 2.2) and states the current ladder (replacement_check_fee), so the solution is unique here; in a world with three or more voids, or voids of different payouts, the schedule's sentence would read against the current rule. Nature: parameter_schema not aligned with the declared overwrite (policy side).
- Policy-side note: `capital_agg_member_payout`'s retired sentence ("assembled per member, not per capital account") is immediately followed in the source by the in-force combination of payable across all of the member's accounts; the KB carries both exactly as the source does.
